import random, itertools
n=14
fixed={(1,11),(0,13),(7,9),(1,13),(4,11),(6,9)}
fixed={tuple(sorted(e)) for e in fixed}
# target all degree4 residual
res=[4]*n
for u,v in fixed:
    res[u]-=1; res[v]-=1
print(res, sum(res))
edges_all=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n) if (i,j) not in fixed]
# random greedy Havel-Hakimi with restarts
for attempt in range(100000):
    d=res[:]
    E=[]
    avail=set(edges_all)
    ok=True
    # maybe choose vertex max degree and connect to random possible largest degrees
    while any(x>0 for x in d):
        # feasibility check no negative
        if any(x<0 for x in d): ok=False; break
        # pick max residual with random tie
        maxd=max(d)
        if maxd==0: break
        candidates=[i for i,x in enumerate(d) if x==maxd]
        u=random.choice(candidates)
        nbrs=[v for v in range(n) if v!=u and d[v]>0 and tuple(sorted((u,v))) in avail]
        if len(nbrs)<d[u]: ok=False; break
        # choose d[u] among nbrs weighted by d perhaps with randomness
        nbrs_sorted=sorted(nbrs, key=lambda v: d[v]+random.random(), reverse=True)
        chosen=nbrs_sorted[:d[u]]
        for v in chosen:
            e=tuple(sorted((u,v)))
            if e not in avail: ok=False; break
            avail.remove(e); E.append(e); d[v]-=1
        d[u]=0
        if not ok: break
    if ok and all(x==0 for x in d):
        allE=sorted(fixed|set(E))
        deg=[0]*n
        for u,v in allE: deg[u]+=1; deg[v]+=1
        print('found', len(allE), deg)
        print(allE)
        break
else:
    print('none')
